summary: The computer apothecary runs on, which every board on the bench is plugged into. Not a product: it stands for whichever machine that is, the way a generic module stands for a kind. Its USB sockets are drawn as one, because a port name says which board answered and not which socket it is in.

jacks.name: usb
jacks.label: USB
jacks.note: Every USB socket of the computer, as one.
